def oven(name, loc):
    root = empty(name, loc)
    box(name + '_b', (3.0, 2.2, 3.0), (0, 0, 1.5), mat('oven_steel', hexc('#c8ccd4'), 0.3, metal=0.5), 0.1, parent=root)
    box(name + '_g', (2.0, 0.1, 1.4), (0, -1.12, 1.6), mat('oven_glow', hexc('#ff9a3a'), 0.3, emit=hexc('#ff8a2a'), estr=3.0), 0.03, parent=root)
    for i in range(3):
        sphere(name + '_k%d' % i, 0.14, (-0.8 + i * 0.8, -1.12, 2.7), mat('knob', hexc('#2a2d33'), 0.4), parent=root, seg=8)
    return root
